classes.label: deterministic offline
classes.reading: An in-process vitest suite over fakes, scripted adapters and committed fixtures: no live service, model, database server or real executable. A link is admitted on pull request only when a pull-request CI job runs it (benchmark-nightly runs on schedule and dispatch only).

classes.label: model-in-loop
classes.reading: A real model (OpenAI or Anthropic) answers inside the loop. A scripted agent, a fake SDK client or a recorded capsule never counts. With no provider credits every row is blocked; the record-only B21 command is no suite and never ran.

classes.label: browser E2E
classes.reading: A Playwright spec driving the real Next.js application in Chromium under the fixture runtime: e2e/ through playwright.config.ts and e2e-orchestration/ through playwright.orchestration.config.ts. Its in-memory stores and scripted agent make it no live run.

classes.label: database-backed
classes.reading: A PGlite suite: real PostgreSQL in-process, admitted to database-delivery. A DB-gated real-server suite (opt-in on a qualification marker) skips in CI and is named in a note with LB-14, never linked.

classes.label: external-provider staging
classes.reading: A live external service other than the model providers - an identity platform, a distributor, a manufacturer or quote API, an external MCP server - in a staging or sandbox account. A fake or a local fake server never counts.

classes.label: physical-hardware validation
classes.reading: A real board, instrument or real executable on a host (FreeRouting, kicad-cli, the pinned ngspice through B22-D's diagnostic runner); never a fake seam. B23-D's hardware|dry_run execution class (physical-evidence.ts:44) is the nearest contract: only a hardware record can satisfy (physical-evidence.ts:394), and eligibility is blocked for every input (physical-evidence.ts:484).
